events.event: Apple sent threat notifications to users in a reported 99 countries and Germany's BSI confirmed Bundestag members and other prominent figures received warnings of possible state-backed zero-click iPhone spyware; CNBC Indonesia's headline framed it as a 'DPR' wiretap although the article is about Germany.
events.key_numbers: 99 countries (figure from a Beirut filmmaker, not independently confirmed) · tens of thousands of users feared targeted · zero-click exploit · attacker unknown
events.why_it_matters: Even iPhones can be hacked without a single tap, and the misleading 'DPR' headline shows how easily this story is misread in Indonesia.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered by CNBC Indonesia, CNN Indonesia, Medcom, Beritasatu

events.event: Binance said the US$6.3 billion hack began with a compromised laptop of a DevOps engineer, giving the attacker access to service containers, and that it covered losses from its SAFU fund.
events.key_numbers: US$6.3 billion (about Rp114.4 trillion) client assets affected · about US$3 billion (Rp54.4 trillion) frozen on-chain · SAFU fund launched 2018 · TRM Labs and Chainalysis point to North Korea (TraderTraitor)
events.why_it_matters: The biggest exchange hack on record started with one employee laptop, a useful lesson for anyone holding crypto on an exchange.
events.spreading_evidence: Two CNBC Indonesia Tech headlines on 2 Nov

events.event: CNBC Indonesia, citing IDEAS surveys, reported that most ojol drivers still earn below Rp100,000 net per day even after the 8% commission cap that Grab and GoTo applied from 1 July 2026.
events.key_numbers: 73.07% earn under Rp100,000 net/day · 7.34% earn Rp150,000+ · survey 23-27 Aug 2026, 531 drivers, 51 regencies/cities, 13 provinces · gross daily income Rp126,313 vs Rp187,628 pre-pandemic · operating cost Rp65,694/day · commission 8% (drivers get at least 92%, was 80%) under Perpres 27/2026
events.why_it_matters: Millions rely on ojol income, and the commission cut promised by the president has not lifted most drivers to minimum wage.

events.event: LG CNS completed a 30 MW AI data center in Jakarta for KMG, a Sinar Mas and Korea Investment Real Asset Management joint venture, with full capacity already pre-sold and expansion to 400 MW in design.
events.key_numbers: 30 MW now · 400 MW planned · over 300 kW per rack (about 60x a typical rack) · air cooling in phase 1, liquid cooling later
events.why_it_matters: Indonesia is becoming an AI data-center hub, which raises questions on power and water use.

events.event: Bisnis.com headline says the Cikarang data center is full and NeutraDC (Telkom group) is expanding its AI infrastructure in Indonesia; the article could not be opened.
events.why_it_matters: Shows AI demand has filled existing data-center capacity in Indonesia.

events.event: Experts told CNBC Indonesia that building security routinely demanding a KTP and a face photo from visitors can breach UU PDP data-minimisation principles, while the data protection oversight agency that should have existed since 17 October 2024 still has not been formed.
events.key_numbers: UU PDP passed 2022 · oversight body due 17 Oct 2024, not yet formed
events.why_it_matters: Almost everyone hands over a KTP at an office lobby, and few know they can question it.
